name: Night Wizard: The VIDEO GAME ~Denial of the World~
original_name: ナイトウィザード The VIDEO GAME～Denial of the World～
source:
A PS2 game adaptation of the "Night Wizard!" anime that includes a new heroine.

Renji Hiiragi is a member of an order of Night Wizards who protect the world from those who would plunge it into darkness. Night Wizards have special abilities and are armed with weapons called artifacts which allow them to attack discarnate beings known as Emulators.

[From [url=http://www.ncsx.com/2008/022508/night_wizard.htm]NCS[/url]]
translation:
根据动画《Night Wizard!》改编的PS2游戏，并加入了一位全新女主角。

柊莲司是“夜之魔法使”组织的成员，他们守护世界，抵御企图令其陷入黑暗的敌人。夜之魔法使拥有特殊能力，并装备称为“魔导具”的武器，可以攻击名为“侵魔”的非实体生命。

[摘自[url=http://www.ncsx.com/2008/022508/night_wizard.htm]NCS[/url]]
